'''Matcha Flavoured 1.0''', "Finally Done", is the first full release of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on July 24, 2026, alongside the developer's design video. Most of its changes are fixes to recipe unlocks and [[Advancements|advancements]], plus the "Golden" music disc.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.0}}</ref>

== Additions ==
* The "Golden" [[Music Disc|music disc]], composed by Ciren and added in memory of the developer's dog, Dakota. The disc was still a demo in this version. See [[Credits]].
* Bookshelf and chiseled bookshelf textures.

== Changes ==
* End stone bricks became [[Brown Sandstone|brown sandstone]], and the vanilla end stone brick recipe is blocked.
* Froglights became [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]].
* The clock recipe changed.
* Deserts no longer have flowers.
* New sky and fog colors for deserts and badlands.

== Fixes ==
* Sweet berry jam no longer appears in [[Bastion Remnant|bastion]] chests.
* Bread found in chests is the same as bread made by players.
* Coal unlocks the coal torch and coal block recipes.
* Red sand can be crafted back from red sandstone, and its recipe unlocks on obtaining an iron nugget.
* Brown sandstone can be crafted back into sandstone, with updated recipe unlocks.
* Bricks can be crafted back into brick items, and the brick recipe unlocks from terracotta and bricks.
* Wool unlocks the string recipe.
* [[Phosphor]] recipes unlock properly.
* Sand and quartz blocks unlock the quartz recipe.
* The gold, copper and iron [[Compass|compasses]] and the bell unlock properly.
* Many other last-minute recipe unlock and advancement fixes.
